title: First hearing New Orleans music
summary: Howard says it was his first New Orleans music and he picked up their tunes fast.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Good. It says here that you went, so I guess you told that to another interviewer, too. And had you heard much New Orleans music before?
Had you heard much New Orleans music before you heard them?
Was that the first you heard?

Yes sir, stayed with me. And when they talk about pickin' up the tunes, pickin' up and learnin' the tunes, sugar--ain't had no trouble with me. I learned them so fast they didn't know--they didn't want me to stay around there. I would play any tune that they had.
When you went down to Rehearsal, you played, too? (inaudible) Is that right?
Sometimes. I just pick up a horn, and start to blowin'. Sometimes. Don't tell nobody that.
Shoot, you'll put it in a book, and I'll get in trouble. I don't wanna' get in trouble. Yeah--
